data.title: Lowe's names execs to oversee Pro services and AI
data.description: The leadership titles, which became official as of Sept. 1, have implications for a range of operations at the Home Improvement retailer.

data.title: Sephora plans exclusive drops for TikTok Shop
data.description: The retailer said products it features in each monthly drop will launch exclusively through Sephora's TikTok Shop. It will later roll out select products to Sephora.com, in certain stores or through other retail partners.

data.title: Amazon adds 'update me when' feature to Alexa for Shopping
data.description: The retailer has also implemented a fraud-prevention feature using AI. Shoppers can ask Alexa for Shopping whether a communication claiming to be Amazon is authentic.

data.title: Descartes acquires Extensiv, adding AI tech to fulfillment solutions
data.description: It marks Descartes' second acquisition in two weeks of AI-powered fulfillment companies.

data.title: David's Bridal touts 99.78% approval rate after anti-fraud solution rollout
data.description: It achieved a 99.78% approval rate within the first two weeks of launch. That has improved authorization performance while reducing unnecessary friction for legitimate guests, according to the retailer.
